item.title: Rocket-maker Orbex is to appoint administrators after funding bids fail
item.description: The Forres-based orbital launch services company and space rocket manufacturer, Orbex, is in the process of appointing administrators after fundraising, merger and acquisition opportunities all concluded unsuccessfully. item.title: The Nicholson Building is demolished
item.description: The Nicholson Building on St Catherine’s Road has been demolished. Built in the late 19th century or early 20th, the building was originally the Forres Carriage and Motor Works.
